Despite having a sound logical basis, the concept of an optimal hypertrophy range has come under scrutiny. With respect to muscle recruitment, fast-twitch fibers begin to be activated when force exceeds 20% of maximal voluntary isometric contraction, and activation of the full motor unit pool occurs at approximately 80% of maximal voluntary isometric contraction (80, 253).
